# WPRI

> > WPRI is a job board and employment platform for career opportunities in Providence, Rhode Island and beyond.

WPRI operates a dedicated jobs portal connecting candidates with employment opportunities across various industries. The platform serves as a centralized recruitment and job search resource for the Providence, RI region.

## Key Topics

- Job Board
- Job Search
- Employment
- Recruitment
- Candidate Portal
- Career Opportunities
- Providence RI
- Global Jobs
- Hiring
- Vacancies

## Jobs & Careers

- [WPRI Jobs Portal](https://jobs.wpri.com/): Search and apply to job vacancies in Providence, RI and globally through the WPRI Jobs candidate portal
